modules.name: Game integration
modules.writePolicy: Game authoring follows scoped scripts, explicit asset ownership and saved-runtime review. The hub only reads this member.
modules.focus: Playable encounter, independent movement/aiming, combat and native delivery.

modules.name: Chamber environment
modules.writePolicy: Keep the candidate separate. Confirm current LFS ownership before any Unreal write.
modules.focus: Architectural parity, fractured concrete, local teal light and haze.

modules.name: Bear Scanner
modules.authority: Scanner repository and versioned bear-pack exports
modules.writePolicy: External member is read-only here. Existing local modifications remain owned by its maintainer.
modules.focus: Capture, reconstruction, export provenance and scale.

modules.name: Character & animation
modules.writePolicy: Versioned diagnostic candidates only until source ownership and static identity are reviewed.
modules.focus: M1 contact ownership remains unresolved. Standing and walk depend on it.

modules.name: Bear Studio
modules.writePolicy: Open the existing Studio. The workspace does not import, rig or promote assets on its behalf.
modules.focus: Inspect exact saved assets and motion before native import.

modules.name: Evidence & review
modules.authority: Frozen decision packages and report manifests
modules.writePolicy: Evidence is read-only. Observations are separate records; technical passes do not record user acceptance.
modules.focus: Measure, save, decide with traceable limitations.

modules.name: Source references
modules.authority: Original video / scan sources and explicit selected concepts
modules.writePolicy: Originals are preserved. Concepts express direction, not measured dimensions or redistribution rights.
modules.focus: Chamber atmosphere and the scanned teddy's identity.

modules.name: Workspace platform
modules.writePolicy: Owns its catalog, snapshots and local work journal. No write authority over connected members.
modules.focus: Planning, federation, review access and durable decisions.

runbooks.title: Inspect the federation
prerequisites: Run from the integration checkout with Python 3.11+.
Member bindings point to the intended checkouts.
runbooks.produces: Timestamped member/artifact inspection and a saved snapshot. No member writes.

runbooks.title: Open evidence review
prerequisites: Run from the integration checkout.
Preserve the frozen report inputs.

runbooks.title: Open Bear Studio
prerequisites: Check whether port 8472 already serves this integration workspace.
Use existing saved revisions; do not overwrite a baseline.
runbooks.produces: The existing saved-asset inspection and animation application.

runbooks.title: Play the saved encounter
prerequisites: Run from the intended game checkout.
Close another Unreal editor/game before launching.
Installed Unreal 5.8.3 and hydrated project assets are required.
runbooks.produces: Saved TeddyEncounter. WASD move; mouse aim; left mouse fire; Space dodge; Escape pause; F5 restart.

runbooks.title: Inspect the separate chamber candidate
prerequisites: Run from the bound chamber worktree, not the integration checkout.
Close another Unreal editor/game.
The candidate has not been promoted or visually accepted.
runbooks.produces: Saved TeddyChamberParity candidate. Compare it against the selected references.

runbooks.title: Verify the contact experiment baseline
prerequisites: Run from the integration checkout.
Read the preregistered protocol before candidate authoring.
runbooks.produces: Hash-pinned input receipt and criteria; no mesh, map or animation changes.

runbooks.title: Check Unreal write ownership
prerequisites: Use the intended repository and authenticated Git remote.
A lock under the same account still requires session coordination.
runbooks.produces: Current remote lock records. This check does not acquire, release or override a lock.

runbooks.title: Verify workspace behavior
prerequisites: Installed Python 3.11+.
Tests use isolated temporary state and bounded loopback ports.
runbooks.produces: Persistence, stale-write protection, dependency, source-boundary and API checks.

runbooks.title: Choose the next agent assignment
prerequisites: Run from the integration checkout.
Read the task contract and preserve independent member ownership.
runbooks.produces: Compact machine-readable queue with readiness and blocking reasons. No model is launched.
